title: Occurrences After Bigram
summary: Given two strings 'first' and 'second', identify all instances where 'second' follows 'first' immediately, and 'third' follows 'second'.
statement: Given two strings 'first' and 'second', identify all instances where 'second' follows 'first' immediately, and 'third' follows 'second'. Return an array of all 'third' words for each identified sequence.
constraints: Words are separated by single spaces.
Return every word immediately following the consecutive pair first,second in order.
reference_solution:
def words_after_bigram(text, first, second):
 words=text.split();return [words[i+2] for i in range(len(words)-2) if words[i]==first and words[i+1]==second]
hints: Inspect each triple of consecutive words.
When its first two equal first and second, append the third.
Every qualifying occurrence has exactly one such triple and scanning preserves order.
editorial: Every qualifying occurrence has exactly one such triple and scanning preserves order.

arguments: alice is a good girl she is a good student
tests.explanation: The pair a good is followed by girl and later student.

arguments: we will we will rock you
tests.explanation: The two occurrences are followed by we and rock.
